opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.summary: The British Academy is pleased to offer this funding scheme to support ambitious projects to engage the public with the humanities and social sciences. These awards, up to £8,000, offer an exciting opportunity for humanities and social sciences researchers to push boundaries and seek imaginative new ways to engage with the public.

opportunities.opportunity_id: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.summary: The British Academy and the Alexander von Humboldt Foundation are pleased to announce a call for applicants for early career scholars in the humanities and social sciences to attend the Knowledge Frontiers Symposium. The research collaboration symposium will take place between Wednesday 21 April 2027 and Friday 23 April 2027.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.summary: The British Academy Postdoctoral Fellowship is a three year award made to an annual cohort of outstanding early-career researchers in the humanities or social sciences.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.summary: The Talent Development Awards are available to promote the acquisition and advancement of skills in relevant areas by UK-based researchers, supporting innovative research methods, be that through skills development, collaboration or dissemination.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: The total funding available per award in this call is up to £300,000 over 2 years

opportunities.summary: The programme aims to support projects which engage with questions concerning the relationship between expertise, public understanding and policy delivery internationally, and highlight the importance of collaboration between communities of practice, disciplines, capacities and borders.

opportunities.opportunity_id: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27

amount.raw: The Academy is offering up to two one-year fellowships hosted in DGAP's offices in Berlin. These are offered as awards for up to £150,000 for 12 months in duration (with Full Economic Costing at 80 per cent).

opportunities.summary: Global Innovation Fellowships provide opportunities to UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences to develop their skills, networks and careers in the creative and cultural, public, private and policy sectors to address challenges that require innovative approaches and solutions.
